### Phase-76 §5 state-0/1 brainstorm (active phase)

- **Pick:** the `Route.redirect` action (`envoy.config.route.v3.RedirectAction`) — the THIRD `Route.action` oneof arm, which envoy-rust WHOLLY LACKS (`RouteAction` is a two-variant enum at `crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:2178`; the `Route` visitor accepts five keys at `:2483-2494`), so a `redirect:` route upstream SERVES is boot-fatal here. Pick + scope: **ADR-0168**. **ADR-0169 RESERVED-UNFIRED** for a `76.1`/`76.2` split.
- **The recon drove the pick, and it also produced two findings that outlived it.** `CF-76-1` (NEW): upstream STRIPS the query before route path matching while envoy-rust matches the RAW target — silent, pre-existing, on the most-exercised surface in the project, pinned by no fixture; NOT fixed here, owner is its own phase. And `CF-75-2`'s join rule, which its own record flagged as UNMEASURED, is now measured (single comma, no space, OWS-trimmed, seen by every value mode, precedes the numeric parse, `cookie` not special-cased) — the divergence stays OPEN and out of scope.
- **Four measured properties, not intuitions, decided it.** Backend-free (zero clusters — so locally verifiable on a host where backend-routing fixtures go RED); zero new harness machinery (`location` is not allow-listed, so `Http1ProbeList` compares it value-exact for free); one dispatch seam that serves BOTH codecs (H2 calls H1's resolver); and 15 deterministic runtime cells + 7 reject-direction rules.
- **The elegant fit:** `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` for a redirect is measured as `direct_response` — the string envoy-rust ALREADY emits from its `DirectResponse` arm — so the new arm reuses the existing constant and adds no access-log surface at all.
- **Scope line = the §6.1 LoC gate.** `regex_rewrite` inside `redirect` is a NON-GOAL (measured working upstream, but it needs substitution machinery) and stays boot-fatal, the house posture already used for `hash_policy`/`retry_policy`/`domains`. Projected ~1340 net LoC / ~16-20 tasks: under both thresholds but within ~11% of the LoC gate, so the PLAN-write must re-derive it.
- **Honest gaps.** `SPEC.md` §7 records SEVEN explicitly NOT-MEASURED items; the fixture-critical ones (302/308 reason phrases, the full response-header set) must be measured at the PLAN-write. One recon probe was silently shadowed by prefix overlap and had to be re-measured — prefix overlap is a live hazard for fixture `0086`.
- **Next:** the §5 **state-2 PLAN-write** (a SEPARATE session per §5.1) — re-verify this SPEC's citations on disk, measure the two open cells, re-derive the estimate, then author `PLAN.md`.

- **The estimate was RE-DERIVED and CALIBRATED, not inherited.** ≈1530 net `crates/`+`tests/` LoC at ≈20-24 tasks, against a ~1500 gate, benchmarked on the measured net LoC of seven recent phases (68→950, 69→1540, 70→1372, 73→873, 74→1981, 75.1→1413, 75.2→897). The parent SPEC had projected ~1340.

State-0 recon was an 18-finding census (R-1…R-18) combining a live drive of the pinned `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` (digest verified by `docker image inspect` BEFORE any probe) with a read-only tree census at `b3a89d3`.
- **WHY THIS SURFACE.** It opens a **zero-row family** — the only one of the four whose opener needs **no new dependency at all** (HTTP/3 needs `quinn` + an `h3spec` gate, gRPC needs a real gRPC data path, WASM is "its own multi-phase sub-project"). It is **backend-free AND cluster-free**, so unlike backend-routing fixtures it is fully verifiable on this host. It needs **ZERO new harness machinery**. And it is the NAMED unblocker for two shipped config types whose `runtime_key` is inert or rejected *because* no runtime layer exists.
- **THE TWO MEASUREMENTS THAT DECIDED IT, AND WHY THEY WERE PROBED FIRST.** (i) Upstream does **NOT** pre-populate its **89** built-in `envoy.reloadable_features.*` flags into `/runtime`; a bare config returns literally `{"entries":{},"layers":[]}`. **The opposite answer would have killed the pick outright**, which is exactly why it was the first thing probed. (ii) `/runtime` is byte-NONDETERMINISTIC (**five distinct md5s over six GETs against one unchanged process**) — and that is fully absorbed by `BodyRule::JsonShape`, because `preserve_order` is enabled NOWHERE so `serde_json::Map` is a `BTreeMap` that canonically key-sorts both sides on re-serialization. **The fix was already in the harness; the temptation was to add an allow-list and weaken the assertion.** This is PLAN-VERIFY **V-2** and the whole fixture design rests on it.
- **THE ROADMAP PLACEMENT WAS A DELIBERATE DEVIATION, ON MEASURED GROUNDS.** The 13 rows under `### Deprecated / edge features` are **not deprecated features** — they are Observability, `HeaderMatcher` and redirect rows that EOF-appended under the file's last heading. Following that practice would have left `### Runtime + hot restart family` at zero rows and failed to move stop-condition leg (iii). Row `108` was therefore INSERTED under its own heading, which also required adding the two table-header lines that heading lacked. **MEASURED: `numstat` exactly `4 0`, six cells on `' | '` with `in-progress` at field 4, one escaped `\|`, census `108 / 107 done / 1 in-progress`, and a whole-file compare proving pure insertion.**

Its record was materially improved regardless (the ADR-0168 DECISION 5 pattern): a **SECOND matcher with the same bug** (`route_match_matches`, `crates/envoy-filter/src/jwt_authn.rs:173-186`), **THREE** unshared in-tree query-strip implementations, the fact that **`plan_redirect` is already query-strip-correct** so phase 76 pre-paid part of the fix, and that "~4 probes" is an **UNDER-COUNT** (8-12, because the two NON-REGRESSION witnesses — query still logged, query still forwarded — need an access-log-observing driver). Also measured: **no existing test and no existing fixture depends on the current behaviour.** **The standing trap for whoever takes it: fix `route_matches`' ARGUMENT, never mutate `req.path`.** Also rejected: the three heavier zero-row families, `CF-75-2`, `CF-75-6`+`CF-75-3` (still the strongest repo-health candidate, but it lights up no fixture at all), the redirect follow-ups `M2-1`/`M2-2`/`M2-3`, `sni_cluster` (still needs a `tls_inspector` listener-filter subsystem envoy-rust lacks) and non-deterministic LB (still behind a contract-relaxation ADR).

- **WHAT THIS SESSION DID NOT DO.** No `PLAN.md` (state 2, a separate session — §5.1/ADR-0127). No code, no test, no fixture, no `cargo` command. No landed artifact edited (D-3.5). - **M-3 is a PLAN over-claim, not an implementation shortfall.** `PLAN.md`'s Task-6 family table assigns six local-reply sites to "this task"; its Step-1 list specifies eight tests, none covering them. The implementation matched the LIST exactly and exceeded it by one (D-4). **Nine of sixteen sites are undriven — but the family is covered BY CONSTRUCTION** (one seam, one bit, and the bit was verified correct at every site by direct trace).
- **M-1: a vacuous assertion on a live cell.** `grpc.rs` asserts `resp.reason == None`, but the only test `Response` constructor hard-codes `reason: None`, so deleting the production `resp.reason = None;` leaves the suite GREEN — while `local_rate_limit` (production) emits `reason: Some("Too Many Requests")` through `SynthFromDecode` to the seam, which would put `HTTP/1.1 200 Too Many Requests` on the wire. One line fixes it.
- **M-7/M-8/M-9 — three record-accuracy findings on `PROGRESS.md`.** The size table lists five of its range's seven files, so the true docs-excluded net is **1290**, not 1165, and "~28% above centre" is **+41.4%** with **42** LoC of worst-case headroom, not 167 (both conclusions survive). D-5 calls the `Cargo.lock` delta "one patch bump" while it also carries `windows-sys 0.61.2→0.52.0` ×3 and `socket2 0.6.3→0.5.10`. D-5's byte-untouched proof used a moving `HEAD` endpoint.
- **What was AFFIRMED.** The seam sits before the log/stats derivation and the placement is genuinely witnessed; `apply_grpc_local_reply` occurs at EXACTLY TWO places workspace-wide and at neither shared builder; HTTP/2 is COMPILER-isolated (`pub(crate) mod grpc;`, E0603); `outgoing_local` is correct at all sixteen sites and does not leak across keep-alive requests; a THIRD H1 write site (`router::write_proxied_response`) is production-dead and proxied, so the two-funnel census holds.
- **V-1, V-2 and V-3 were re-derived from disk and are ALL CONFIRMED**, with V-2 EXTENDED by M-2. **Four subagent findings MOVED on main-session re-verification** — two `Important`s downgraded to Nits, M-3 reframed from implementation shortfall to PLAN over-claim, and one claim PARTIALLY REJECTED as false. The dissent is recorded by name in `REVIEW.md` §5. CI was re-confirmed independently on `577a567` (run 32257501630, steps 15/13, jobs by NAME).
- **Nothing was fixed** (§6.3; ADR-0165): the `109.2` M-1…M-8 / N-1…N-11, the `109.1` and `108.2` Minor/Nit sets, CF-110-1…5 and the whole CF ledger are BANKED and carried unchanged. **No ADR fired** — head stays `ADR-0179`, `ADR-0180` UNRESERVED.
